norm_perturbation.generator: dedicated torch.Generator (does not consume the global model-init RNG)
norm_perturbation.draw_order: model.modules() order, weight then bias per norm; after the last norm, glb_GN then sub_GN (N(0, 1) each)
norm_perturbation.note: every norm affine is perturbed before the checkpoint is saved so the 13 norms are mutually distinct and the two zero-initialized 4096-wide learnable separators (glb_GN, sub_GN) are non-zero; the strict golden discriminates the composite model's norm and separator wiring

provenance.clip_swap_note: the bundled CLIP_VIT_LARGE_PATCH14_336_CONFIG constant (recorded pristine above) is swapped in the dynamic module for a tiny CLIPVisionConfig (image_size 336, patch 14, 3 channels, hidden 1024, intermediate 128, 16 heads, 3 layers, projection dim 768, layer_norm_eps 1e-5, eager attention) before any model build; the width 1024 cannot shrink because reshape_hd_patches_2x2merge asserts L == 24*24 and C == 1024
provenance.reference_dtype_note: every weight is rounded to bfloat16 before saving and before any golden is computed; the reference model loads the stored bf16 tensors up-converted to float32 (strict load), so the golden exercises the exact stored-bf16 -> float32 path the Java model uses when it upcasts the checkpoint
provenance.shared_embedding_note: the bundled Phi3VModel registers its single embed_tokens module twice: Phi3ImageEmbedding is built with wte=self.embed_tokens (the commented-out weight copy right below the construction is a no-op because the module object is shared), so model.state_dict() carries 77 keys for 76 unique tensors. The checkpoint stores the shared embedding once, under model.embed_tokens.weight (the generator asserts the two state-dict keys share storage before saving); the reference's strict load re-supplies the duplicate model.vision_embed_tokens.wte.weight key from the same tensor. Text rows in every forward (image and text-only) are embedded from that one table, so the golden's Java-side embed_tokens lookup is the reference's own path
provenance.attention_note: Phi3VPreTrainedModel._supports_sdpa is False, so eager (or FA2) is the only legal implementation; the generator sets _attn_implementation = 'eager' on both build configs and asserts it on the built model and its CLIP vision model after construction
provenance.attention_mask_note: the reference's own processor mask is (ids > -1000000) = all ones; every forward passes an explicit all-ones long mask, which the WP1 probe pinned as equivalent to None under the bundled 4d causal-mask builder (sliding_window omitted, bundled default None)
provenance.pad_token_id_note: config.json carries pad_token_id 0: the bundled Phi3VModel.__init__ builds nn.Embedding(vocab_size, hidden_size, padding_idx=config.pad_token_id) and the bundled config default 32000 is out of range for a 21-token vocabulary; _init_weights zeros the pad row (row 0) of the stored embedding
provenance.embd_pdrop_note: the config omits embd_pdrop (bundled default 0.0), so Phi3VModel.embed_dropout and Phi3ImageEmbedding.drop are nn.Dropout(0.0), no-ops under the reference's eval mode
provenance.encoding_note: the checkpoint tokenizer is the 21-token phi3v-tiny fixture (no added tokens, a ByteLevel post-processor with no special tokens), so the per-chunk add_special_tokens=True encoding adds nothing -- no per-encoding <s> (unlike the 32k artifact tokenizer). Chunks are encoded with the pinned tokenizers library loaded from the checkpoint's own tokenizer.json, mirroring Phi3VPromptExpander.expandRendered's per-chunk HfTokenizer.encode(chunk, addSpecialTokens=true)
provenance.tower_note: the reference runs the full 3-layer CLIP encoder over all five slots per image (the zero-padded slots included) and takes hidden_states[-2] -- the state after block 1; Java executes the two executed blocks over the real slots only and loads the third block plus the pooled-output post_layernorm without executing them: the extra reference compute is discarded and the retained rows are bit-identical
provenance.decode_reference_note: every step's logits (entry 0 is the prefill point) are a fresh full uncached forward over the expanded prompt plus the generated history, with the sentinel IDs intact in input_ids: the bundled Phi3ImageEmbedding.forward substitutes the image rows natively (clamp_min(0).clamp_max(vocab_size) then index_put), so the golden never exercises the boundary-recompute of prepare_inputs_for_generation -- that path (pinned lines 1650-1655) is recorded for the Java re-prefill design only
provenance.rope_note: NTK-Su scaling with uniform short factors 1.0 and long factors 2.0 over the 32 head-dim/2 frequencies: every width at or below 470 runs the short table, every width above it the long table; the wide-cross-boundary case (465 prompt tokens) crosses at total width 471, re-running the whole history as a fresh prefill (golden recompute_step 6), while the wide-long-prompt case (473) shows the image rows alone (457) below the boundary pin the selection to the finished prompt length
provenance.greedy_id_note: the recorded greedy IDs vary across steps (observed [0, 3, 8, 13, 20]); the strict suite asserts them exactly, but the binding gate is the full logit-vector comparison against this golden at 1e-4
